name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Private stateful Git/code workflow plugin with immutable SQLite project versions and human-controlled HIL promotion.

interface.shortDescription: Govern code tasks through immutable SQLite PVs.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane governs one Git project, one agent, and one bounded task through exact source capture, visible ChatLineage, deterministic PV Exit, and a five-way human HIL gate.
defaultPrompt: Boot Evidence Lane for my registered code project.
Search my accepted PV before changing code.
Build the next PV candidate and stop at HIL.
